name: get_device_family
description: Returns which subsystem a device belongs to: insteon, z-wave, zigbee, matter, plugin, or unknown. Call this before any INSTEON-only diagnostic tool (get_dev_links_table, get_iox_links_table, compare_device_links) to confirm the device is actually INSTEON -- those silently return nothing useful for a non-INSTEON device. Free-standing -- callable any time.

device_id.description: The device's real id, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE.
